description: This file defines a React component called MenuLayout that composes and manages the layout of a menu with optional panel components, including drag-to-resize functionality, responsive behavior, and state management using hooks.

classes.name: MenuWrapperInspectProps
classes.description: Interface for the props that can be passed to menu wrapper components, allowing external control over panel visibility and other properties.

methods.name: MenuLayout
methods.description: A higher-order React component that accepts list and panel components, returning a composite layout with features like draggable sidebar and responsive panel toggling.
